questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Introduction to Computer System and Instruction Set Architecture
questions.text: Explain Von Neumann Architecture vs Harvard Architecture with diagrams. Explain the Stored Program Concept and Instruction Cycle (Fetch, Decode, Execute).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Introduction to Computer System and Instruction Set Architecture
questions.text: Compare RISC (Reduced Instruction Set Computer) vs CISC (Complex Instruction Set Computer) architectures in terms of instruction format, addressing modes, CPI, and compiler complexity.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Central Processing Unit and Control Unit Design
questions.text: Explain General Register Organization and Stack Organization (Reverse Polish Notation evaluation using stack).

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Central Processing Unit and Control Unit Design
questions.text: Compare Hardwired Control Unit vs Microprogrammed Control Unit design. Explain Horizontal Microinstruction vs Vertical Microinstruction formats with control word examples.

Explain Booth's Multiplication Algorithm for signed 2's complement binary numbers. Trace Booth's algorithm for multiplying multiplicand $M = (-9)_{10} = 10111_2$ and multiplier $Q = (+6)_{10} = 00110_2$.
Explain Restoring Division Algorithm and Non-Restoring Division Algorithm with step-by-step register trace tables.

Explain Linear Instruction Pipelining (4-segment and 5-segment pipelines: IF, ID, EX, MEM, WB). Calculate Speedup ($S$), Efficiency ($\eta$), and Throughput ($TP$) of a $k$-stage pipeline for $n$ instructions.
Explain Pipeline Hazards: Structural Hazards, Data Hazards (RAW, WAR, WAW hazards and forwarding/bypassing), and Control Hazards (Branch prediction and branch delay slots).

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Memory Organization and Input-Output Systems
questions.text: Explain Memory Hierarchy (Registers, L1/L2 Cache, Main Memory, Secondary Storage) in terms of speed, cost, and capacity.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Memory Organization and Input-Output Systems
questions.text: Explain Cache Memory Mapping Techniques: Direct Mapping, Fully Associative Mapping, and Set-Associative Mapping (2-way / 4-way). Calculate Tag, Set/Line, and Word fields for a given main memory and cache size.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Memory Organization and Input-Output Systems
questions.text: Explain Cache Write Policies: Write-Through (with write buffer) vs Write-Back (with dirty bit), and Cache Replacement Policies (LRU, FIFO, LFU, Random).

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Memory Organization and Input-Output Systems
questions.text: Explain I/O Data Transfer Modes: Programmed I/O, Interrupt-Driven I/O, and Direct Memory Access (DMA). Explain DMA Controller (8237) architecture, Burst Mode, and Cycle Stealing mode.
